title: Batch normalization

paper.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Batch normalization: normalize channel activations in a plain convolutional network and measure time to a fixed validation quality. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cifar10; required output: [N,3,32,32] -> [N,10] logits. Evaluate time_to_quality (minimize). Train/eval statistics separation; quality target requires calibration. Required ablation: Remove normalization and retune only the documented learning-rate grid. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
